# Keep an empty OAuth grant distinct from an omitted option

658 documents and implements grantedScope === undefined as grant every requested scope, while an empty string grants none. Current submitOAuthLogin keeps that distinction before checking permission boxes. Proposed manual default-value rule for this test API: check undefined explicitly, rather than using a truthy fallback that would turn denial into a full grant. Tests exercise the empty-string denial case, not merely the default case.

Scope: OAuth test defaults and syntax.
